# Introduction to Balaji Amines Limited

Balaji Amines Limited is a leading specialty chemicals manufacturing company headquartered at 165-A Railway Lines, Solapur - 413001, Maharashtra, India. Established in 1988, the company has grown to become one of the largest manufacturers of aliphatic amines in India and a prominent player in the global chemical industry. With over three decades of expertise, Balaji Amines has carved a distinguished niche for itself in the production of methylamines, ethylamines, and a wide range of specialty chemicals and derivatives that serve diverse industrial applications.

The company's robust product portfolio includes Mono Methyl Amine, Di Methyl Amine, Tri Methyl Amine, Mono Ethyl Amine, Di Ethyl Amine, Tri Ethyl Amine, and various derivatives such as Dimethyl Formamide (DMF), Dimethyl Acetamide (DMAC), Morpholine, N-Methyl Pyrrolidone (NMP), and many more. These products find extensive use in pharmaceuticals, agrochemicals, refineries, rubber chemicals, water treatment, photographic chemicals, and other industries, both domestically and internationally.

Balaji Amines operates state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities in Solapur and Bidar, equipped with advanced technology and stringent quality control systems. The company is committed to excellence, innovation, sustainability, and customer satisfaction, adhering to international quality standards and environmental regulations. With a strong export presence in over 50 countries, Balaji Amines Limited continues to strengthen its position as a trusted name in the global specialty chemicals market, driven by skilled professionals, continuous research and development, and a vision for sustainable growth.
